description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a wrapper around GLib functions, including classes GlibWrapperFactory and GlibWrapper, for use within the Rialto server component. It provides methods for GObject property management, signal handling, type information, and memory management, facilitating interaction with GLib in a C++ environment.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: A concrete implementation of IGlibWrapper that wraps GLib functions for use in C++ code.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of IGlibWrapper.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IGlibWrapper instance, creating it if necessary.
